remarks: Hi, I’m 100 S Doheny #221, a bright, updated one-bedroom condo sitting right where West Hollywood, Beverly Hills, and the best of Los Angeles all start to blur together. Step inside and you’ll find an open, easygoing floor plan with plenty of natural light, recessed lighting, and a living and dining space that feels surprisingly generous. My updated kitchen keeps things clean and modern with quartz counters, two-tone cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and a breakfast bar that makes it easy to cook, entertain, or just keep the conversation going.
